highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 restores CPU bitmap-rendering performance and reduces shaping and color-conversion overhead.

breaking.title: Remove whitespace after the color prefix
breaking.body: SKColor.Parse and TryParse now reject whitespace immediately after # in six- and eight-digit forms. Remove that whitespace before parsing; ordinary outer whitespace and case-insensitive hexadecimal input remain supported.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to m151 without changing the managed API or native C API.
Adds ReadOnlySpan<char> parsing for SKColor, SKFourByteTag, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag so callers can parse slices without allocating substrings. Color and tag parsing also do less work per call.
SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply use managed math with native-equivalent results, avoiding per-color interop calls.
UTF-8 string insertion reuses an encoding buffer, and SKShaper reads glyph results through spans instead of copying two native arrays. Shaping output is unchanged.
SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) disposes the intermediate full image when Subset returns a different instance, while preserving same-instance returns.
Restores the previous optimized CPU shader path for scaled and tiled bitmap drawing, addressing high CPU use, dropped frames, and flicker in affected applications.
Corrects a native use-after-free when corrupt serialized GPU text data is rejected.
Corrects stencil-clear coordinates, ensures stencil is cleared when preservation requires it, and restores dirty tracking when a resolve task does not execute.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 native archives for .NET 11 and compiles them with its new exception-handling model. .NET 8 and .NET 9/10 retain their existing toolchain mappings.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added .NET 11 WebAssembly archives and cross-backend visual regression coverage, and cleaned up a redundant WASM build define.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Restored CPU bitmap-rendering performance, moved single-color conversions to managed math, and fixed intermediate subset-image cleanup. Added matching .NET 11 WebAssembly archives and exception handling, plus Ganesh stencil and resolve corrections.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Added span-based color and tag parsing and reduced shaping allocations. Color parsing now rejects whitespace immediately after #, and native GPU text teardown is corrected.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Opened the m151 line with the Skia engine update and no managed API changes from that sync.

harfbuzz_summary: Reduces UTF-8 insertion allocations and adds span-based Tag.Parse. Matching Emscripten 5.0.6 archives are provided for .NET 11; the native HarfBuzz version remains 14.2.1.

v4.151.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 previews the Skia m151 engine.
v4.151.0-preview.1.1.body: The engine sync adds no managed API changes.

v4.151.0-preview.2.1.headline: This preview reduces text-shaping overhead and adds span-based parsing.
v4.151.0-preview.2.1.body: SKColor and tag parsers accept spans, while shaping avoids temporary encoding and glyph-array allocations. Remove whitespace immediately after # in color input; native GPU text teardown is also corrected.

v4.151.0-rc.1.1.headline: This release candidate restores optimized CPU bitmap rendering.
v4.151.0-rc.1.1.body: It also reduces single-color interop overhead, corrects subset-image cleanup, and adds matching .NET 11 WebAssembly archives and exception handling. Ganesh stencil and resolve tracking are corrected.

v4.151.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 promotes the release candidate to stable.
v4.151.0.body: There are no additional collected PR changes since Release Candidate 1.
